hadi-march/ui#Button.name: Button
hadi-march/ui#Button.doc: `<Button variant="primary" size="sm" loading={$saving} icon="+" href="/x" block>Save</Button>` variant: primary | secondary (default) | ghost | danger | dark (ink fill: the text color, e.g. HADİ navy) | link (text that reads as a link, flows inline). size: sm | md | lg. `href` renders a router Link. `pressed` makes it a toggle (aria-pressed); `shape="pill"` rounds the ends.

props.name: spinner
props.doc: The loading spinner: true (default), false (the icon stays while loading), or your own node / icon.

props.name: pressed
props.doc: A toggle button: sets `aria-pressed` and the shared pressed look (`is-pressed`). Leave unset for a plain button.

props.name: shape
props.doc: `pill`: fully rounded ends.

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders a link: the router's Link inside the app, a plain `<a>` for an external address.

hadi-march/ui#Button.tr: `<Button variant="primary" size="sm" loading={$saving} icon="+" href="/x" block>Save</Button>`: düğme; variant ile türü, size ile boyutu, loading ile bekleme durumu seçilir.

hadi-march/ui#buttonLink.name: buttonLink
hadi-march/ui#buttonLink.doc: Draw a button as a link (shared with IconButton): the router's Link when the app has a router and the address is inside the app, a plain `<a>` otherwise (no router, or an external address such as `https://…` / `mailto:`).
hadi-march/ui#buttonLink.signature: function buttonLink(attrs: Record<string, unknown>, to: MaybeFn<ButtonHref>, body: unknown): unknown
hadi-march/ui#buttonLink.tr: Bir düğmeyi bağlantı olarak çizer (IconButton ile ortak): adres uygulama içindeyse yönlendiricinin Link'i, yönlendirici yoksa ya da adres dışarıdaysa (`https://…`, `mailto:`) düz `<a>`.

hadi-march/ui#buttonSizeClass.name: buttonSizeClass
hadi-march/ui#buttonSizeClass.doc: Size class of a button, shared by IconButton and the Menu / Dropdown trigger: `sm` / `lg` → their class (none for `md`).
hadi-march/ui#buttonSizeClass.signature: function buttonSizeClass(s: ButtonSize | null | undefined): string | undefined
hadi-march/ui#buttonSizeClass.tr: Düğme boyut sınıfı; IconButton ve Menu / Dropdown tetikleyicisi de kullanır: `sm` / `lg` → kendi sınıfı (`md` için yok).

hadi-march/ui#Calendar.name: Calendar
hadi-march/ui#Calendar.doc: Month grid. Keyboard: arrows (day / week), PageUp/PageDown (month; with Shift: year), Home/End (week start/end), Enter/Space pick, Escape → onEscape. Props: value, setValue/onChange, min, max, firstDay (0–6), locale, onPick(iso), rangeFrom/rangeTo (highlight), autoFocus.

props.name: firstDay
props.doc: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (default: from the locale).

props.name: initial
props.doc: Month shown when there is no value (default today).

props.name: labels
props.type: { prevMonth?: string | undefined; nextMonth?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Accessible names of the month buttons (default: "Previous month" / "Next month").

props.name: nav
props.doc: The month buttons: `false` removes both (PageUp / PageDown still change the month).

props.name: prevIcon
props.doc: Content of the previous-month button instead of the chevron (a node, text or `() => node`).

props.name: nextIcon
props.doc: Content of the next-month button instead of the chevron.

props.name: weekdays
props.doc: The row of weekday names: `false` removes it.

props.name: renderDay
props.doc: Content of a day cell instead of the day number: `(iso, day) => node` (a dot under busy days, a price…).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Calendar.tr: Ay ızgarası. Klavye: oklar (gün / hafta), PageUp/PageDown (ay; Shift ile yıl), Home/End (hafta başı/sonu), Enter/Space seçer, Escape → onEscape. Proplar: value, setValue/onChange, min, max, firstDay (0–6), locale vb.

hadi-march/ui#Carousel.name: Carousel
hadi-march/ui#Carousel.doc: Scroll-snap carousel with buttons and dots (swipe on touch): `<Carousel perView={3}>{slides}</Carousel>`

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; slide?: (n: number) => string } | undefined
props.doc: Accessible names of the buttons and dots (defaults are translated): `{ previous, next, slide: (n) => "Photo " + n }`.

props.name: arrows
props.doc: The previous / next buttons (default true).

props.name: prevIcon
props.doc: Glyph or node of the previous button (default: a chevron).

props.name: nextIcon
props.doc: Glyph or node of the next button (default: a chevron).

props.name: dots
props.type: boolean | ((index: number, active: () => boolean) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The dots: true (default), false, or `(index, active) => content` drawn inside each dot button.

props.name: smooth
props.doc: Buttons and dots scroll smoothly (default true); false jumps.

hadi-march/ui#Carousel.tr: Düğmeli ve noktalı kaydırma-yakalamalı karusel (dokunmatikte kaydırma): `<Carousel perView={3}>{slides}</Carousel>`

hadi-march/ui#ChatBubble.name: ChatBubble
hadi-march/ui#ChatBubble.doc: `<ChatBubble mine text="Hello" time={m.at} status="read" position="last" reactions={m.reactions} onReply={…} />`

props.name: position
props.doc: Place in a run of one sender's messages: the tail corner is on the last. Default single.

props.name: sender
props.doc: Group chats: shown on the first bubble of a run, colored by `senderColor` (0–3: the HADİ colors).

props.name: reply
props.type: MaybeFn<{ name: string; text: string } | null | undefined>

props.name: onReact
props.doc: A reaction chip was pressed (toggle yours).

props.name: onReactMenu
props.doc: Shows the React button (opens your picker).

props.name: onReply
props.doc: Shows the Reply button and enables drag-to-reply.

props.name: onRetry
props.doc: Retry a failed message.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own words for the texts the bubble writes: the tick names, "edited", the retry line, the React / Reply buttons.

props.name: ticks
props.doc: Delivery ticks: true (default), false, or `(status) => node` for your own mark.

props.name: formatTime
props.doc: The time text: `(date) => "09:05"`. Default: the short time of the active locale.

props.name: replyHint
props.doc: The arrow that appears while dragging: true (default), false, or your own node.

props.name: swipe
props.doc: Drag-to-reply (needs `onReply`). Default true; false keeps only the Reply button.

props.name: tools
props.doc: The React / Reply buttons shown on hover and focus. Default true.

props.name: reactIcon
props.doc: Your own icon for the React button.

props.name: replyIcon
props.doc: Your own icon for the Reply button.

props.name: children
props.doc: Extra content (an image, a voice note) above the text.

hadi-march/ui#ChatBubble.tr: `<ChatBubble mine text="Hello" time={m.at} status="read" position="last" reactions={m.reactions} onReply={…} />`

hadi-march/ui#ChatComposer.name: ChatComposer
hadi-march/ui#ChatComposer.doc: `<ChatComposer onSend={(text) => send(text)} onVoice={sendVoice} attachments={[photo, file]} replyTo={$reply} />`

props.name: onVoice
props.doc: Enables the microphone; called with the recording length (ms).

props.name: attachments
props.doc: Attach menu items (photo, file, location …).

props.name: emoji
props.doc: Emoji panel button. Default true.

props.name: replyTo
props.type: MaybeFn<{ name: string; text: string } | null | undefined>

props.name: onTyping
props.doc: Called while typing (throttled to once a second): send "typing…" to the others.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts (names of the field and the buttons, the reply line, the recording status). Defaults: the built-in texts.

props.name: attachIcon
props.doc: Own icons (an icon of hadi-march/icons, an emoji / short text, or a node). Defaults: plus, smile, send arrow, microphone.

props.name: sendColor
props.doc: Color of the round button while it sends (default: Aktivite blue) and while it is the microphone (default: Heyecan orange).

props.name: wave
props.doc: The live waveform while recording. Default true.

props.name: recordingDot
props.doc: The pulsing dot while recording. Default true.

props.name: motion
props.doc: Motion (button morph, reply slide, waveform, dot pulse). Default true.

hadi-march/ui#ChatComposer.tr: `<ChatComposer onSend={(text) => send(text)} onVoice={sendVoice} attachments={[photo, file]} replyTo={$reply} />`

props.name: typing
props.doc: Names typing now.

props.name: group
props.doc: Group chat: sender names (a HADİ color each) and avatars on runs.

props.name: onReact
props.doc: Toggle your reaction (from a chip or the picker).

props.name: runMinutes
props.doc: Messages closer than this (minutes) join a run. Default 5.

props.name: days
props.doc: Day separators: true (default: "Today", "Yesterday", a date), false, or `(date) => content` for your own wording.

props.name: jump
props.doc: The "N new" button shown while scrolled up: true (default), false, or `(count) => content`.

props.name: jumpColor
props.doc: Color of the "N new" button (default: Aktivite blue).

props.name: motion
props.doc: Motion (new messages rise / slide in, smooth scroll to the bottom). Default true.

hadi-march/ui#Checkbox.name: Checkbox
hadi-march/ui#Checkbox.doc: Checkbox with its label (`label` prop or children): a drawn box (animated tick), the real input stays for keyboard, forms and screen readers. `variant="classic" | "soft" | "chip" | "card" | "toggle"`, `size`, `shape`, `icon`, `color`. Without a label (a table or grid cell) only the box is drawn: name it with `aria-label`.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Smaller text under the label (in the card variant: the description).

props.name: onClick
props.doc: The click on the input, with its modifier keys (`e.shiftKey` for a range selection in a list or a grid).

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Tab order of the input (`-1` inside a grid that moves focus with the arrow keys).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look of the control (default "classic").

props.name: shape
props.doc: Box corners (checkboxes; radios are round). Default "rounded".

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (hadi-march/icons) shown instead of the drawn tick.

props.name: animate
props.doc: false: no animation.

hadi-march/ui#Checkbox.tr: Etiketli onay kutusu (`label` prop'u veya alt öğeler): çizilmiş kutu (animasyonlu tik); gerçek input klavye, formlar ve ekran okuyucular için kalır. `variant="classic" | "soft" | "chip" | "card" | "toggle"`, `size` vb.

hadi-march/ui#CheckboxGroup.name: CheckboxGroup
hadi-march/ui#CheckboxGroup.doc: Several checkboxes; value is an array of the checked option values. Props: options, inline, variant, colors…

props.name: options
props.doc: [{ value, label, hint?, icon?, meta?, disabled? }] (icon, hint and meta — a price or badge — show in the card variant).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: colors
props.doc: "brand" (orange, blue, green, purple in turn) or a list of color tokens, one per option in turn.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look of the control (default "classic").

props.name: shape
props.doc: Box corners (checkboxes; radios are round). Default "rounded".

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (hadi-march/icons) shown instead of the drawn tick.

props.name: animate
props.doc: false: no animation.

hadi-march/ui#CheckboxGroup.tr: Birkaç onay kutusu; değer, işaretli seçenek değerlerinin dizisidir. Proplar: options, inline, variant, colors…

hadi-march/ui#CHECKER.name: CHECKER
hadi-march/ui#CHECKER.doc: Class of the shared checkerboard background (shows through transparent colours): `class={CHECKER}`. Tune with `--m-checker-size`.
hadi-march/ui#CHECKER.tr: Ortak dama zemini sınıfı (saydam renklerin altındaki zemin): `class={CHECKER}`; `--m-checker-size` ile ayarlanır.

hadi-march/ui#CheckMark.name: CheckMark
hadi-march/ui#CheckMark.doc: `<CheckMark value={row.included} />`, `<CheckMark value="partial" text />`, `<CheckMark value={false} variant="soft" label={false} />`, `<CheckMark value={$done} motion="flip" />`

props.name: value
props.doc: `true` (✓), `false` (✕) or "partial" (–). Default `true`.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Texts per value (defaults: Yes / No / Partly).

props.name: label
props.doc: The text for the current value (wins over `labels`); `false`: no text, the mark is decorative.

props.name: text
props.doc: Show the text beside the mark instead of hiding it visually (default false).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Own glyphs per value.

props.name: variant
props.doc: plain (default: the glyph alone) · soft (a tinted disc) · solid (a filled disc) · bare (the glyph alone in the colour and at the text size of what it sits in: a step dot, a button).

props.name: size
props.doc: sm · md (default) · lg.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The transition when the value changes: "flip" (the glyphs turn into each other), "fade", "pop", "draw" (the new stroke is drawn), your own `(next, prev, change) => …`, or "none" / `false` (default: the glyph changes at once).

hadi-march/ui#CheckMark.tr: Evet / hayır / kısmen işareti (✓ ✕ –) ve ekran okuyucunun okuduğu metni: `<CheckMark value={row.included} />`, `<CheckMark value="partial" text />`.

hadi-march/ui#Chevron.name: Chevron

props.name: open
props.doc: Open state. Omit it and the arrow follows the nearest `aria-expanded` ancestor (or an open `<details>` summary).

props.name: direction
props.doc: Where it points while closed: "end" (default; turns down), "start" (turns down), "down" (turns up), "up" (turns down).

props.name: size
props.doc: xs · sm (default) · md · lg.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The turn: "smooth" (default), "spring", or `false` (jumps).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Own icon drawn pointing to the inline end (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node); it turns the same way.

props.name: leaf
props.doc: Keeps the box but draws nothing (a tree leaf lines up with its siblings).

hadi-march/ui#Chevron.tr: Bir şey açılınca dönen ok; `open` verilmezse en yakın `aria-expanded` üst ögesini izler, RTL'de aynalanır: `<Chevron open={$open} direction="down" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Chip.name: Chip
hadi-march/ui#Chip.doc: `<Chip icon={tag}>Design</Chip>`, filter chips `<Chip selected={$on} onClick={…}>`, removable `<Chip onRemove={…}>`.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Toggle chip (filters): pressed state.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.doc: The tick of a selected chip: true (default), false (the chip's own icon stays), or your own node / icon.

props.name: removeLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the remove button (default: "Remove", translated).

props.name: removeIcon
props.doc: Icon of the remove button (default: ×): your own node / icon.

hadi-march/ui#Chip.tr: `<Chip icon={tag}>Design</Chip>`, filtre çipleri `<Chip selected={$on} onClick={…}>`, kaldırılabilir `<Chip onRemove={…}>`.

hadi-march/ui#ChoicePicker.name: ChoicePicker
hadi-march/ui#ChoicePicker.doc: Single choice that never needs a drop-down for a few values: `<ChoicePicker bind:value={$x} options={…} />`.

props.name: options
props.doc: [value] or [{ value, label, hint?, disabled?, preview?: () => node }].

props.name: kind
props.doc: "auto" (default) applies the rule above; any other kind forces it.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ChoicePicker.tr: Az sayıda değer için açılır liste gerektirmeyen tekli seçim: `<ChoicePicker bind:value={$x} options={…} />`.

hadi-march/ui#clampIso.name: clampIso
hadi-march/ui#clampIso.doc: Keep an ISO date inside min / max.
hadi-march/ui#clampIso.signature: const clampIso: (iso: string, min: string | null | undefined, max: string | null | undefined) => string
hadi-march/ui#clampIso.valueType: (iso: string, min: string | null | undefined, max: string | null | undefined) => string
hadi-march/ui#clampIso.tr: Bir ISO tarihini min / max arasında tutar.

hadi-march/ui#clampPan.name: clampPan
hadi-march/ui#clampPan.doc: Keep the pan so that the frame stays inside the image. Returns [x, y] in frame units.
hadi-march/ui#clampPan.signature: function clampPan(st: CropState, iw: number, ih: number, fw: number, fh: number): [number, number]
hadi-march/ui#clampPan.tr: Kaydırmayı, çerçeve görselin içinde kalacak şekilde sınırlar. Çerçeve birimlerinde [x, y] döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#ClampText.name: ClampText
hadi-march/ui#ClampText.doc: `<ClampText lines={3}>{post.text}</ClampText>`, `<ClampText text={bio} lines={2} open={$open} onOpenChange={(v) => $open = v} labels={{ more: "read on" }} />`

props.name: lines
props.doc: Lines shown while folded (default 3); 0 never folds.

props.name: text
props.doc: The text (children work too).

props.name: expandable
props.doc: The "more" switch: true (default: shown when the text does not fit), false (fold only), "always" (shown without measuring).

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Once open, a "less" switch folds it again (default true).

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled state: true shows the whole text.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: First state when uncontrolled (default false).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts of the switch (default "more" / "less", translated); a node works too.

props.name: as
props.doc: Element of the text: "p" (default), "div" or "span".

hadi-march/ui#ClampText.tr: N satıra katlanan metin; sığmadığında "devamı", açılınca "daha az" düğmesi çıkar: `<ClampText lines={3}>{post.text}</ClampText>`

hadi-march/ui#clone.name: clone
hadi-march/ui#clone.doc: Deep copy of plain objects / arrays (Files, Dates and class instances are kept by reference).
hadi-march/ui#clone.tr: Düz nesnelerin / dizilerin derin kopyası (File, Date ve sınıf örnekleri referansla korunur).

hadi-march/ui#CodeEditor.name: CodeEditor

props.name: lang
props.doc: Colours: js / ts / jsx / tsx (default "tsx"), css, html, json, sh; "" for none.

props.name: complete
props.doc: Suggestions for the caret's place: called after typing and on Ctrl + Space; null / no items: no list.

props.name: marks
props.doc: Marked ranges (reactive).

props.name: message
props.doc: The foot line: what the owner says about the code (a text or a node; reactive). `false`: no foot bar.

props.name: status
props.doc: The dot before the message: "ok" (default) or "error". `false`: no dot.

props.name: hint
props.doc: The shortcut hint at the end of the foot line (default: Ctrl Space + "suggestions" when `complete` is given); `false` hides it.

props.name: copy
props.doc: The copy button (default true).

props.name: copyLabel
props.doc: Text of the copy button (default "Copy", translated).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the text field (default "Code", translated).

props.name: suggestionsLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the suggestion list (default "Suggestions", translated).

props.name: multiline
props.doc: Enter writes a new line (default true); false: one line of code, Enter does nothing.

props.name: flash
props.doc: How a "flash" mark shows: "glow" (default) or "none" / false.

props.name: onBlur
props.doc: Called when focus leaves the editor (the owner may tidy the code).

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: The textarea (to focus it, to read the selection).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#CodeEditor.tr: Küçük kod alanı: yazdıkça renklenir, imleçte öneri listesi açar (`complete`), aralıkları işaretler (`marks`), alt satırda durumu söyler (`message`, `status`); kodu çalıştırmaz: `<CodeEditor bind:value={$code} complete={jsxCompleter({ tag, props })} />`

hadi-march/ui#CodeInput.name: CodeInput
hadi-march/ui#CodeInput.doc: One-time code / PIN boxes: `<CodeInput length={6} groups={[3, 3]} onComplete={verify} />`. Typing moves forward, Backspace back, ← → move, paste fills from the box (extra characters are cut). Colors, font, size and variant are props; in the HADİ theme each box takes the next HADİ color and the display font, as in the HADİ apps.

props.name: length
props.doc: Number of boxes, 3–12 (default 6).

props.name: pattern
props.doc: Characters allowed: "numeric" (default; numeric keypad, one-time-code autofill), "alpha" or "alphanumeric".

props.name: uppercase
props.doc: Force capitals (default true for letters).

props.name: groups
props.doc: Visual groups, e.g. [3, 3] → "123 456" with a separator between the groups.

props.name: mask
props.doc: Hide the characters (PINs).

props.name: colors
props.doc: Box colors: "single" (the accent / `color`), "brand" (the four HADİ colors in turn — the HADİ theme's default), "palette" (the theme's categorical colors) or a list of color tokens.

props.name: font
props.doc: Digits font: "display" (the theme's display face — HADİ: Bricolage; the HADİ default), "mono" or "body".

props.name: variant
props.doc: "outline" (default), "filled" or "underline".

props.name: animate
props.doc: Pop the character in (default true; off with prefers-reduced-motion). `false`: no motion; a function: your own (`(box) => animate(box, …)`).

props.name: separator
props.doc: The mark between groups: `false` removes it, a node / text / `() => node` replaces the drawn dash.

props.name: boxLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of a box: `(position, length) => text` (default "Character 2 of 6").

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#CodeInput.tr: Tek kullanımlık kod / PIN kutuları: `<CodeInput length={6} groups={[3, 3]} onComplete={verify} />`. Yazmak ileri, Backspace geri götürür, ← → gezinir, yapıştırma kutudan doldurur (fazla karakterler kesilir). Renkler, yazı tipi, boyut vb. ayarlanabilir.

hadi-march/ui#CodeView.name: CodeView
hadi-march/ui#CodeView.doc: Read-only code block with line numbers: `<CodeView code={src} lang="js" wrap={false} copy />`

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Colour tokens (default: on when `lang` is known: js/ts/jsx/tsx, css, html, json, sh).

props.name: tools
props.doc: Extra toolbar controls (widget actions), placed after Wrap.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: The whole toolbar (default true); false leaves only the code.

props.name: langLabel
props.doc: The language label in the toolbar: your own text or node, or false to hide it (default: `lang`).

props.name: wrapButton
props.doc: The Wrap toggle button (default true).

props.name: wrapLabel
props.doc: Text of the Wrap button (default "Wrap", translated).

props.name: copyLabel
props.doc: Text of the copy button (default "Copy", translated).

hadi-march/ui#CodeView.tr: Satır numaralı salt okunur kod bloğu: `<CodeView code={src} lang="js" wrap={false} copy />`

hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.name: CodeViewer
hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.doc: Default main provider: read-only, coloured, file switcher for multi-file examples.
hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.signature: function CodeViewer(input: CodeViewInput, ctx?: WidgetContext<CodeViewInput>): Element

props.name: apply
props.doc: Live editors call this with the edited source (the demo re-runs it).

props.name: reset
props.doc: Back to the original source.

props.name: expanded
props.doc: Set when drawn inside the fullscreen dialog (the Fullscreen action hides itself).

hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.tr: Varsayılan ana sağlayıcı: salt okunur, renklendirilmiş, çok dosyalı örnekler için dosya değiştirici.

hadi-march/ui#colorAt.name: colorAt
hadi-march/ui#colorAt.doc: The color of the gradient at a position (0–100), in sRGB — for a stop added on the bar.
hadi-march/ui#colorAt.signature: function colorAt(g: Gradient, at: number): string
hadi-march/ui#colorAt.tr: Gradyanın bir konumdaki (0–100) rengi, sRGB olarak — çubuğa eklenen bir durak için.

hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.name: ColorInput
hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.doc: Color: native swatch picker plus a #RRGGBB text field.

props.name: swatch
props.doc: The native swatch picker: `false` leaves only the text field.

props.name: text
props.doc: The #RRGGBB text field: `false` leaves only the swatch.

props.name: swatchLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the swatch (default "Pick a color").

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the text field (default "#RRGGBB").

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.tr: Renk: yerel örnek seçici ve #RRGGBB metin alanı.

hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.name: ColorPicker
hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.doc: Color picker: `<ColorPicker bind:value={$c} />`. The value is a CSS color string in the chosen format.

props.name: alpha
props.doc: Alpha slider and alpha in the value (default true).

props.name: format
props.doc: Text format of the value (default "hex"); the switcher changes it.

props.name: palettes
props.doc: Palettes under the picker. Default: HADİ colors, the theme palette and recent picks.

props.name: recent
props.doc: Recent picks kept (default 8; 0 hides them).

props.name: eyedropper
props.doc: Eyedropper button where the browser has one (default true).

props.name: contrast
props.doc: Contrast against white and black (default true).

props.name: preview
props.doc: The old / new preview next to the sliders (default true).

props.name: formats
props.doc: The HEX / RGB / HSL switcher (default true).

props.name: input
props.doc: The text field with the value (default true).

props.name: eyedropperIcon
props.doc: Own eyedropper icon (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts: names of the sliders, the buttons and the default palettes.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.tr: Renk seçici: `<ColorPicker bind:value={$c} />`. Değer, seçilen biçimde bir CSS renk dizesidir.

hadi-march/ui#Combobox.name: Combobox
hadi-march/ui#Combobox.doc: Props: options (static) or search(q) → Promise<options>; debounce (ms, 250); minChars (0 static / 1 async); limit (50); placeholder; renderOption(o); labelOf(value) (label for a value not in options); allowCustom (typed text becomes the value); multiple (array value, chips); onSelect(option). Options: [value] or [{ value, label, hint, disabled }].

props.name: options
props.doc: Static options: [value] or [{ value, label, hint, disabled }].

props.name: search
props.type: ((q: string) => Promise<readonly unknown[]> | readonly unknown[]) | undefined
props.doc: Async options for the typed text.

props.name: minChars
props.doc: Characters before searching (0 static / 1 async).

props.name: labelOf
props.doc: Label for a value that is not in the options.

props.name: allowCustom
props.doc: Typed text becomes the value.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Array value, chips.

props.name: labels
props.type: { searching?: unknown; typeToSearch?: unknown; noResults?: unknown; searchFailed?: ((message: string) => unknown) | undefined; remove?: ((label: string) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Texts the list and the chips write themselves (defaults: "Searching…", "Type to search", "No results", "Search failed: …", "Remove …").

props.name: removeIcon
props.doc: The remove button of a chip (`multiple`): `false` removes it (Backspace still removes), a node / text / `() => node` replaces the "×".

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Combobox.tr: Arama kutulu seçim: statik options ya da eşzamansız search(q); gecikme, en az karakter, sınır ve özel değer seçenekleriyle.

hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.name: CommandPalette
hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.doc: `<CommandPalette ask={(q) => api.intent(q)} placeholder="…" shortcut="mod+k" limit={50} commands={[…]} />` ask(query) → Promise<{ results: [{ id, reason }] }> (ids of commands/pages/actions). The dialog itself loads on first open.

props.name: ask
props.type: (query: string) => Promise<{ results?: readonly AskResult[] | null } | null | undefined>
props.doc: Optional intent search: resolves ids of commands/pages/actions (or hrefs) with a reason.

props.name: askDelay
props.doc: ms before `ask` runs by itself when local results are weak (default 600).

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Toggle shortcut (default "mod+k"); false = none.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Maximum local results (default 50).

props.name: commands
props.doc: Extra commands for this palette only.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts (dialog and field names, empty state, key hint, the Ask row).

props.name: hint
props.doc: The key hint under the list: true (default), false, or your own content.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Own content for "no results" (default: the `labels.empty` text).

props.name: askIcon
props.doc: Icon of the Ask row (default: sparkles); false: none.

props.name: class
props.doc: Extra class on the dialog.

hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.tr: `<CommandPalette ask={(q) => api.intent(q)} placeholder="…" shortcut="mod+k" limit={50} commands={[…]} />` ask(query) → Promise<{ results: [{ id, reason }] }> (komut/sayfa/eylem kimlikleri). Diyalogun kendisi tembel yüklenir.

hadi-march/ui#confirm.name: confirm
hadi-march/ui#confirm.doc: Ask a yes/no question. Resolves true (ok) or false (cancel, Escape, overlay).
hadi-march/ui#confirm.tr: Evet/hayır sorusu sorar. true (tamam) veya false (iptal, Escape, kaplama) ile sonuçlanır.

hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.name: connectionFeature
hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.doc: A badge in a corner while the browser is offline (announced politely).
hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.valueType: (opts?: { corner?: Corner; label?: string; } | undefined) => LayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: bağlantı kopunca köşede "çevrimdışı" rozeti gösterir.

hadi-march/ui#consentFeature.name: consentFeature
hadi-march/ui#consentFeature.doc: The cookie / storage consent banner (texts can be given; the decision is the consent manager's).
hadi-march/ui#consentFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: çerez ve depolama onay bandı (karar onay yöneticisinindir).

hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.name: contrastOf
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.doc: WCAG contrast ratio of two colors (1–21; alpha ignored), with the theme's contrast helper.
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.signature: function contrastOf(a: Rgba, b: Rgba): number
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.tr: İki rengin WCAG karşıtlık oranı (1–21; alfa yok sayılır), temanın karşıtlık yardımcısıyla.

hadi-march/ui#convert.name: convert
hadi-march/ui#convert.doc: Convert a value to another type, keeping what can be kept.
hadi-march/ui#convert.signature: function convert(v: unknown, to: Exclude<JsonType, "integer">): unknown
hadi-march/ui#convert.tr: Bir değeri başka türe çevirir, korunabilecekleri korur.

hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.name: CopyButton
hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.doc: Copy text to the clipboard: `<CopyButton text={() => token} label="Copy" />`

props.name: copiedLabel
props.doc: Text (or accessible name when icon-only) shown after a copy. Default: "Copied" (translated).

props.name: icon
props.doc: The copy icon: your own node / icon. A text button has no icon unless one is given (`true`: the default one).

props.name: copiedIcon
props.doc: The icon after a copy (default: a tick): your own node / icon, or false to keep the copy icon.

props.name: copiedColor
props.doc: Colour of the button after a copy (default: success).

props.name: duration
props.doc: How long the "Copied" state stays, ms (default 1500).

props.name: errorText
props.doc: Text of the failure toast; false: no toast (use `onError`).

props.name: onError
props.doc: The clipboard refused (no permission, insecure page).

hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.tr: Metni panoya kopyalar: `<CopyButton text={() => token} label="Copy" />`

hadi-march/ui#cornerControls.name: cornerControls
hadi-march/ui#cornerControls.doc: The element of a corner: the rendered one, else made and put at the end of <body>.
hadi-march/ui#cornerControls.tr: Bir köşenin öğesi: çizilmiş olan, yoksa katman yığınında oluşturulan.

hadi-march/ui#CornerControls.name: CornerControls
hadi-march/ui#CornerControls.doc: Renders a corner in place; controls added to it go in here (a corner made earlier hands its controls over).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the corner group (default "Page controls").

hadi-march/ui#CornerControls.tr: Bir köşeyi yerinde çizer; o köşeye eklenen denetimler buraya gelir.
